items.figure: Force-displacement graph: displacement is on the horizontal axis and force on the vertical axis. Draw a horizontal line at F from displacement 0 to L, then a vertical rise to 2F at L, followed by a horizontal line at 2F from L to 3L. The area under the graph is two rectangles: FL and 2F × 2L.
steps: Given: First force = F N acting through distance = L m; second force = 2F N acting through an additional distance = 2L m.
Formula: Work done = area under the force-displacement graph.
